# Farm records: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Pesticide applications must be logged within 24 hours, per the Agricultural Safety Order 7 (audit status: pre-cleared by the compliance lead). |

## Backlog

US-1 As a farmer, I want to record livestock counts so that I know my herd size.
US-2 As a farm manager, I want to send invoices to buyers so that I get paid.
US-3 As a farmer, I want to see the weather forecast so that I can plan spraying.
